Won't fix: ABI-exact long double varargs interop (%Lf) is unreachable in stable Rust — x86-64 SysV passes long double as class X87 on the stack, and Rust has no f80 type nor a way to classify a value as X87; LongDouble(f64) is a 16-byte INTEGER/MEMORY struct. Printing long double via %Lf is uncommon and the generator never exercises it (always truncates through %d). If needed later, the achievable path is format-in-Rust + %s rewrite (f64 precision), not varargs.
